notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to 1.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lucius the Eternal, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to 1.
When Lucius the Eternal dies, it triggers, exiling it from your graveyard and choosing the creature targeted in step 1.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, destroying it.
When the creature dies, Lucius the Eternal triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
When Lucius the Eternal enters the battlefield, Confusion in the Ranks, Blasting Station and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters the battlefield, Confusion in the Ranks and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Confusion in the Ranks trigger, exchanging control of the Myr and an artifact or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 1.
